        <navPoint id="num_33" playOrder="32" class="chapter">
          <navLabel>

          </navLabel>

        </navPoint>
        <navPoint id="num_34" playOrder="33" class="chapter">

            <text>幸福是一种选择</text>
          </navLabel>

        </navPoint>
        <navPoint id="num_35" playOrder="34" class="chapter">

            <text>幸福需要活在当下</text>

        <navPoint id="num_36" playOrder="35" class="chapter">

        </navPoint>
        <navPoint id="num_38" playOrder="37" class="chapter">

            <text>成功不一定带来幸福</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0039.html#1565U0-ff741281aacf4695af6103674ebcef50"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint id="num_39" playOrder="38" class="chapter">
          <navLabel>
